usecases.title: Inspect a storyboard cut in a browser contact sheet
Produce an Instant Exports promotional video

criteria.text: Each cut has a total duration of 10 seconds.
Each cut runs at 30 frames per second.
Shot 1 title in each cut reads exactly “Exports in one click”.
Shot 1 background in each cut is dark navy.
Shot 1 in each cut has exactly one lime accent line drawn left to right.
Shot 2 in each cut shows a white app card.
The app card table in each cut has three rows.

expected.operand: lime Export CSV button in shot 2

criteria.text: Shot 2 in each cut shows a lime “Export CSV” button.
The counter in each cut reads 0 at 0:03.
The counter in each cut reads exactly 10,000 rows by 0:06.
Shot 3 text in each cut reads exactly “Live today for every plan”.

expected.operand: ledgerline.app visible in every inspected frame from 0:08 through 0:10

criteria.text: ledgerline.app remains visible in each cut from 0:08 through the end.

expected.operand: any rendered content in the bottom 35% of any portrait frame

criteria.text: No content occupies the bottom 35% of any frame in the 9:16 cut.

tests.title: Landscape contact sheet matches all three Instant Exports shots
tests.summary: On the landscape contact sheet, inspect measured dimensions, duration, frame rate and all three shots, including exact titles, counter endpoints and sustained URL visibility.

steps.heading: Step 1
steps.body: Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=16x9 in the browser and inspect the Ledgerline landscape contact-sheet header after it reads “ready”, then assert it measures 1920×1080 pixels, reports a duration of 10 seconds and 30 fps, and declares shots at 0:00–0:03, 0:03–0:07 and 0:07–0:10.

steps.heading: Step 2
steps.body: In the landscape sheet’s labelled shot-1 frames and layer facts table for 0:00–0:03, inspect the hook, then assert the title is exactly “Exports in one click” on dark navy with exactly one lime accent line drawn left to right.

steps.heading: Step 3
steps.body: In the landscape sheet’s labelled shot-2 frames and layer facts table for 0:03–0:07, inspect the proof card at the specified timecodes, then assert a white app card contains a three-row table and a lime “Export CSV” button, with the counter reading 0 at 0:03 and exactly 10,000 rows by 0:06.

steps.heading: Step 4
steps.body: In the landscape sheet’s labelled shot-3 frames and layer facts table for 0:07–0:10, inspect the call to action and every labelled frame from 0:08 through the final frame, then assert the text reads exactly “Live today for every plan” and ledgerline.app is visible in each frame from 0:08 to the end.

tests.title: Portrait contact sheet has no content in the bottom 35%
tests.summary: On the portrait contact sheet, inspect all frames for any content in the bottom 35% of the image; detect prohibited occupancy, not merely show the safe-zone overlay.

steps.heading: Step 1
steps.body: Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=9x16 in the browser and reach the Ledgerline portrait contact sheet once its header reads “ready”.

steps.heading: Step 2
steps.body: On the portrait contact sheet, turn on “Show safe zones” and inspect every labelled storyboard frame against the shaded bottom 35% band, then assert no rendered content occupies that bottom band in any frame.
